activities.title: Cold Storage Unit C Temperature Spike Incident
activities.workCompleted: Conducted physical audit of Cold Storage Unit C at 08:30 AM. Found thermostat controller sensor wire loosened by forklift vibration near Bay 7. Re-anchored sensor with insulated cable bracket.
activities.decisionsMade: Decided to quarantine 120 cartons of Almond Beverage (Batch #ALM-992) for 4 hours until Quality Lead Rajesh completed microbiological culture testing.
activities.problemsEncountered: Temperature had drifted to 8.2°C for approximately 55 minutes, exceeding the 4.0°C threshold.
activities.actionsTaken: Logged cold-chain deviation in SOP-WH-04 logbook. Directed technician Manoj to install secondary digital data logger as fail-safe.
activities.pendingTasks: Receive sign-off from Rajesh Kulkarni before clearing Batch #ALM-992 for outward dispatch tomorrow morning.
activities.observationsLessons: Cold storage door curtain flaps need replacement every 90 days; air curtain velocity was weakened by torn vinyl strips.

activities.title: Weekly Cycle Count - Perishable Nut Milk SKUs
activities.workCompleted: Completed physical verification of 1,450 cartons of 500ml and 1L Almond/Cashew beverages across Bays 3, 4 and 5.
activities.decisionsMade: Prioritized FIFO dispatch for 140 cartons of batch expiring on Dec 15; stickered pallets with fluorescent green tags.
activities.problemsEncountered: Discrepancy of 18 cartons in Bay 4: Physical count was 412 cartons while ERP showed 430 cartons.
activities.actionsTaken: Cross-referenced CCTV footage of yesterday's night loading dock. Identified that 18 cartons were loaded onto truck MH-04-GP-1200 without scanner confirmation due to dead battery in handheld scanner #3.
activities.pendingTasks: Coordinate with logistics coordinator Amit Verma's team to reconcile delivery challan with DMart Thane receiver stamp.
activities.observationsLessons: Handheld scanners must be left in the multi-dock charging cradle overnight; night shift supervisor must enforce docking checklist.

activities.title: Packaging Supplier RMA Rejection - Apex PolyPrint
activities.workCompleted: Inspected incoming shipment of 5,000 corrugated outer cartons from vendor Apex PolyPrint (PO #PO-99120).
activities.decisionsMade: Rejected the entire consignment after 4 out of 10 sample cartons failed Edge Crush Test (ECT < 32 lbs/in). Refused gate entry.
activities.problemsEncountered: Apex PolyPrint sales rep claimed their internal test report passed, threatening to delay tomorrow's retail packaging line.
activities.actionsTaken: Issued official Defect Rejection Certificate countersigned by Vikram Malhotra. Enclosed calibrated micrometer and bursting strength gauge readings.
activities.pendingTasks: Source 2,000 emergency buffer cartons from secondary backup vendor 'PackWell Solutions' at 8% premium rate.
activities.observationsLessons: Single-sourcing corrugated cartons carries operational shutdown risk during peak Diwali/Q3 demand. Dual-vendor split (70/30) is urgently needed.

activities.title: Warehouse Slotting Optimization for High-Velocity Festive SKUs
activities.workCompleted: Drafted revised floor layout blueprint shifting high-turnover Almond 500ml SKUs 40 meters closer to primary loading Dock #2.

activities.pendingTasks: Handover physical floor blueprint with color-coded weight limits to successor Neha Patel before departure.
activities.observationsLessons: Never stack glass jar pallets higher than two tiers in mezzanine without side-safety containment mesh.

documents.title: SOP-WH-04: Daily Warehouse Reconciliation & FIFO Cycle Count Procedure
documents.summary: Standard operating procedure for daily physical inventory reconciliation, RF barcode terminal verification, and lot expiration tagging across Bhiwandi Hub.
documents.contentSnippet: All perishable nut milk SKUs must be counted across primary racking bays 1 to 14. Any discrepancy exceeding 5 cartons must trigger dock supervisor investigation and CCTV timestamp review. Handheld RF terminals must be docked in central charging bay by 18:30 daily.
keyTakeaways: Daily cycle count mandatory by 08:30 AM before outbound loading begins
Perishable stock expiring within 45 days must be marked with green FIFO stickers
All manual adjustments in ERP require two-person supervisor authentication

documents.title: LOG-SOP-12: Cold-Chain Logistics Incident & Temperature Excursion Protocol
documents.summary: Mandatory emergency protocol for handling reefer truck mechanical breakdowns, highway congestions, and temperature spikes above 4.0°C in transit.

Manual driver logs are deemed non-compliant without encrypted USB logger download.

Tamper-evident cellular temperature loggers must be activated at dispatch gate
Maximum permissible deviation: 4.0°C ± 1.5°C for maximum 30 continuous minutes

documents.title: STRAT-Q3-OPS: ABC Consumer Products Supply Chain Resilience Plan
